You will hear Mia telling Dad how her friends are traveling on Saturday.
Dad: Is Leo taking the bus?
Mia: No, Leo is taking the tram to the castle.
Dad: What about Eva?
Mia: Eva is sailing to the island by boat.
Dad: And Sam?
Mia: Sam is walking to the library with his sister.
Dad: Is Ruby going by train?
Mia: Yes, Ruby is taking the train to the next town.
Dad: What is Alex doing?
Mia: Alex is flying to Spain with his mum.
